result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. One minor cosmetic/content issue was found: a discount badge on the pizza card displays '-0%', which is a meaningless value and likely a data or formatting defect.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) shows '-0%', which conveys no actual discount and looks like a data/formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or ensure the backend supplies a valid non-zero percentage before rendering the badge.
